g.text: Energy use per person vs. GDP per capita
Energy refers to total energy supply, measured in kilowatt-hours per person. Gross domestic product (GDP) is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026) and other sources
Note: GDP data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
